title: [Change Log] Preserve SystemId for unloaded record modifications
summary: Change Log Management now preserves the SystemId from persisted records when modifications are recorded without the record being loaded first, fixing incorrect null SystemId values in change entries.
key_points: Uses already-loaded record data from Change Log instead of reading database when SystemId is null
Maintains existing public signatures and behavior without adding database queries
Adds test coverage for modifying records by primary key without pre-loading
Fixes SystemId on modification entries in change log
Resolves issue where failed insert attempts had separate platform trigger timing behavior
